chzhunshan-za-chas.start: 中山广场 — begin on the outer pavement on whichever side is convenient. If arriving by metro, follow signs for 中山广场; no particular station exit is prescribed.
chzhunshan-za-chas.finish: 中国银行大连市分行（横滨正金银行大连支店旧址）, 中山广场9号 — view the former Yokohama Specie Bank from the street.
chzhunshan-za-chas.distanceNote: Walking and viewing times are editorial estimates. Roughly 1 km including detours and crossings: an editorial estimate of the walk’s scale. The distance has not been measured along the current pedestrian network; check the route in Amap’s “步行” mode.
chzhunshan-za-chas.access: This walk uses public pavements to view exteriors. It makes no claim about opening hours, prices or permission to enter buildings. Temporary barriers and the availability of crossings have not been checked on site; follow signs and current walking navigation.
